implication_verbatim: Greatly reduced metabolism of tertiary amines compared to normal metabolizers. Decreased conversion of tertiary amines to secondary amines may affect response or side effects.
recommendation_verbatim: Avoid tertiary amine use due to potential for sub-optimal response. Consider alternative drug not metabolized by CYP2C19. Utilize therapeutic drug monitoring to guide dose adjustments.
